name: Zodiac MyStamp Folder (Tiger) with Spring Decorative MyStamp Sheet (MYTIGFDL)
page_name: Zodiac MyStamp Folder (Tiger) with Spring Decorative MyStamp Sheet (MYTIGFDL)
description: Celebrate the Year of the Tiger this CNY with SingPost. This commemorative A4 MyStamp folder features a tiger illustration, signifying wealth and good fortune, and explains the significance of each of the zodiac animals. There’s a MyStamp sheet inside the folder featuring a stamp tab for each of the 12 animals with a large decorative stamp tab depicting a reigning tiger with gold ingots and jewellery. An additional decorative Spring MyStamp sheet is also included, which shows a tiger with treasure pot of gold ingots. Start your collection now with a new zodiac animal MyStamp folder each Chinese New Year!
